drug_name: Calcarea Phosphorica, Kali Phosphoricum, Ferrum Phosphoricum, Kali Sulphuricum, Magnesia Phosphorica (Combination Biochemic / Tissue Salts)
what_its_for: This combination of five tissue salts (mineral cell salts) is traditionally used to support the body's natural balance of minerals. Each salt plays a specific role: Calc Phos helps build bones, teeth, and supports growth. Kali Phos supports the nervous system and helps with stress, fatigue, and mental tiredness. Ferr Phos helps carry oxygen in the blood and supports the body at the early stages of inflammation or infection. Kali Sulph helps with skin health and the smooth flow of oxygen to cells. Mag Phos helps relax muscles and is commonly used for cramps, spasms, and nerve pain. Together, this combination is often used for general weakness, tiredness, growing pains in children, convalescence (recovery after illness), nerve exhaustion, and overall nutritional support. This is a homeopathic / biochemic product and is not a substitute for conventional medical treatment.
how_to_take: Place the tablets under your tongue and let them dissolve slowly — do NOT swallow them whole with water right away. Take them at least 15 to 30 minutes before a meal or 30 minutes after a meal for best results. Try not to eat, drink, or brush your teeth right before or right after taking these tablets. Handle the tablets as little as possible — tap them into the bottle cap and place them directly under your tongue. Avoid touching them with your hands if possible, as this may reduce their effectiveness.
dosing: Adults and children over 12 years: Take 4 tablets, 3 to 4 times daily, or as directed by your doctor or homeopathic practitioner. Children 6 to 12 years: Take 2 tablets, 3 to 4 times daily, or as directed by your practitioner. Children under 6 years: Use only under the guidance of a qualified practitioner. Tablets are generally very safe, but always follow the dose recommended by your healthcare provider. Do NOT take more than the recommended dose thinking it will work faster.
missed_dose: If you miss a dose, simply take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do NOT double up or take two doses at the same time to make up for a missed one.
storage: Store at room temperature, away from direct sunlight, heat, and moisture. Keep the bottle tightly closed. Do not store in the bathroom or near the kitchen sink where it is warm and humid. Keep out of reach of children and pets. Do not use the tablets after the expiry date printed on the label. Store away from strong-smelling substances such as camphor, eucalyptus oil, or perfumes, as strong odors may affect biochemic remedies.
what_to_avoid: Avoid consuming coffee, mint, menthol (including mint toothpaste), camphor, or strong-smelling substances close to the time you take these tablets, as they may interfere with the action of the remedy. Avoid eating or drinking anything 15 to 30 minutes before and after taking the tablets. Avoid tobacco and alcohol close to the time of your dose. Do not store or take these tablets near strong-smelling substances.
when_to_call_doctor: Call your doctor or healthcare provider if: your symptoms do not improve after 4 to 6 weeks of regular use; your symptoms get worse at any time; you develop new or unexplained symptoms; you experience an allergic reaction such as rash, itching, swelling, or difficulty breathing (this is rare but seek emergency help immediately); you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, and have not yet discussed using this product with your doctor; your child seems to be getting worse or not growing as expected; you have any serious underlying medical conditions such as kidney disease, heart disease, or diabetes — always let your prescribing doctor know about ALL supplements and medications you are taking.
when_it_works: Biochemic tissue salts work gradually and gently. Most people begin to notice a difference within 2 to 4 weeks of regular use. For longer-standing conditions or general health support, it may take 4 to 8 weeks or longer to see the full benefit. Unlike strong pharmaceutical medicines, these salts work by gently correcting mineral deficiencies at the cellular level. Consistency is important — take them regularly every day as directed for the best results.
special_populations: Pregnancy and Breastfeeding: These tissue salts are generally considered gentle and are sometimes used during pregnancy, but always consult your doctor or midwife before use. Elderly patients: Generally safe, but consult your doctor if you are taking other medications. Children: Safe for children but dose must be adjusted by age — see dosing section. Patients with lactose intolerance: Most biochemic tablets contain lactose (milk sugar) as a base. If you are lactose intolerant or allergic to dairy, speak with your pharmacist or doctor before using these tablets. Patients with diabetes: The lactose content in standard biochemic tablets is very low, but if you are closely managing blood sugar, discuss with your doctor. Patients on prescription medications: Tissue salts are generally not known to interact with conventional medicines, but always inform your doctor or pharmacist about everything you are taking.
